turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Wednesday going? I imagine it's starting to get pretty warm out there in Phoenix.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, definitely. It is already scorching hot here. To keep things cool and get a bit of energy, I actually made myself a whisked green tea powder latte with some cold steamed milk this morning before heading out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a delicious and refreshing way to start a hot day! Did you have an easy trip to the clinic today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It wasn't too bad. I just drove my hybrid car in today, which was nice because I could blast the air conditioning the whole way.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move. Having good AC is a must in Phoenix during June! Did you get a chance to take a proper break for lunch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I sat down in the break room and had a sandwich I packed using two slices of my latest home-baked wild-yeast loaf. It turned out really well.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A homemade sourdough sandwich is hard to beat! How has your baking been going lately with the rising temperatures?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's a bit of a challenge, honestly. The kitchen gets so warm that the fermentation happens incredibly fast, so I have to keep a really close eye on the dough so it doesn't overproof.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes sense, yeast definitely loves the warmth! How are things going with Tom? Have you two made any more decisions about the summer 2028 wedding?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Things are great with Tom! We haven't locked in any major details recently since 2028 is still quite a while away, but we've been casually browsing some outdoor venue options online.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's nice to take your time and enjoy the process without any rush. Have you managed to find any time for your online Italian lessons lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, yes! I spent about twenty minutes on a lesson last night. It's a nice way to transition my brain away from work mode.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Che bello! It's wonderful that you're sticking with it. Do you have any plans for the rest of your evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not much, just going to head home, relax with Tom, and probably get an early night. Talk to you tomorrow!
